interpretation: Use the authors' documented benchmark conventions to close the data stage. Preserve the approved wealth correction and disclose reconstruction differences; do not require a bespoke historical claim-valuation model.
source_vintage: Fresh WRDS and official JKP source captures, September 10–11, 2026, through December 2025

source_rules.features: Supplied 115 JKP features; 57 observed minimum; monthly empirical CDF before final validity; exact raw zeros remain zero; missing ranks become 0.5
source_rules.eligibility: Released NYSE, return-availability, dollar-volume, SIC, lookback, upper-half/minimum-50 and 12-row addition/deletion rules
source_rules.missing_future_returns: Complete per-security first-to-last observed monthly grid; drop rows with all twelve future returns missing; replace individual missing excess leads by zero
source_rules.terminal_G_M: Retain the JKP supplied delayed-value and missing-delisting conventions as benchmark assumptions
source_rules.exits: Source propagates holdings only for IDs in the next eligible weight vector; omitted IDs have no separate liquidation-trade entry; every such transition is inventoried for Step 4
source_rules.market: Use the official published JKP USA value-weighted excess market directly, as the authors use a supplied market file
source_rules.risk_scaling: Portfolio-ML uses the square root of covariance diagonals and the source cross-sectional median fallback for unavailable lagged scales; raw rvol_m is not the core normalization input

reconstruction_differences.wealth: Approved reciprocal compounding; exact USD 10 billion at December 31, 2020
reconstruction_differences.included_delisting_values: R1 uses CIZ monthly excess returns for A/P/V when observed, avoiding a second application of included event values; R0 supplied returns remain separately available
reconstruction_differences.stock_total_returns: R1 adds the actual outcome-month CRSP bill subtraction rate; original decision-month French-RF totals remain explicitly named R0 columns
reconstruction_differences.daily_returns: CIZ observed daily total returns less monthly CRSP 30-day bill return divided by 21; retained raw missing daily returns are omitted from regressions as in the source
reconstruction_differences.features: Retain vendor features as supplied, including documented upstream issues; do not insert the separately rebuilt raw-volatility diagnostics into predictors
reconstruction_differences.end_date: Fresh continuation through December 2025 for the already approved exposed-robustness period; last supported decision November 2025

acceptance_scope: A reproducible data package for Step 4 validation of the named historical paper benchmark reconstruction
limitations: The current vendor vintage is not established to equal the authors' original input vintage. Exact published-statistic replication is not claimed.

The source uses future-return availability when selecting observations. Historical comparisons using this universe are conditional paper benchmarks, not certified causal executable investment records.

Zero excess returns, delayed-value attribution, missing-delisting assumptions and disappearance from the next weight vector are benchmark conventions, not verified cash receipts or realistic liquidation prices and costs.
Published features retain documented upstream return-filter and return-construction issues. Fixing included delisting values in outcome columns does not rebuild every affected predictor.

The separate constituent reconstruction retains a maximum 0.2890477361 basis-point discrepancy from the official market file. The benchmark input is the publisher file; constituent equality is not claimed.
CIZ daily observations are a current reconstruction input with documented precision differences from legacy daily exports.
Imputed forward cells at the December 2025 boundary do not make twelve-month or thirty-six-month extension labels mature. Later steps must enforce actual outcome calendars.
No portfolio backtest, covariance-engine acceptance, live execution readiness or prospective data lock is certified by Step 3.
supersedes: The proposed additional carried-claim valuation policy and the requirement to reproduce the publisher market from every constituent before accepting a supplied-market benchmark
